control: reversed proportionality (CED 11.3.A.2: resistance is proportional to resistivity and LENGTH and inversely proportional to CROSS-SECTIONAL AREA)
title: What the resistance of a uniform resistor depends on
body: The resistance of a resistor with uniform geometry is proportional to its resistivity and its cross-sectional area, and inversely proportional to its length.

control: explicitly excluded by the CED (11.x BOUNDARY STATEMENT: descriptions of charging and discharging RC circuits in AP Physics 2 are limited to qualitative descriptions and representations)
title: Charge on a charging capacitor in an RC circuit

control: wrong owner topic (equivalent resistance in series and parallel is topic 11.5, EK 11.5.A; 11.3 covers the resistance of a single object)
title: Equivalent resistance of resistors in parallel
body: The inverse of the equivalent resistance of resistors connected in parallel equals the sum of the inverses of the individual resistances.

control: swapped meter connections (CED 11.5.C.1.i: ammeters connect in SERIES; 11.5.C.2.i: voltmeters connect in PARALLEL)
title: How to connect circuit meters
body: How each meter must be connected to make its measurement.

items.label: Ammeter
items.meaning: connected in parallel with the element whose current is being measured

items.label: Voltmeter
items.meaning: connected in series with the element across which potential difference is measured

control: hook expansion contradicts the CED (11.5.A.2.iii: adding resistors in parallel increases the number of paths and DECREASES the equivalent resistance). The entry is correct, so only the hook should be rejected.
title: Adding resistors in parallel
body: When resistors are connected in parallel, the number of paths available to charges increases and the equivalent resistance of the group decreases.

expands_to.means: raises the equivalent resistance of the group

hooks.when_to_use: when predicting how a parallel branch changes equivalent resistance
hooks.caution: State the change in CED terms when answering.
